description.description: Short site description. Used as the llms.txt summary line.

base_url.description: Absolute origin of the published site (e.g. https://docs.example.com). Makes llms.txt links absolute; base_path is appended to it.

base_path.description: URL path prefix for all routes. Default '/'. Use '/docs' to host at example.com/docs/.

stylesheet.description: Path to the Tailwind CSS entrypoint. Applied uniformly to every page type (markdown, HTML, OpenAPI, proto).

content.description: Content root directory. Files here become routes. Default 'docs'.

templates.description: Optional directory holding an llms.txt template override. Tailwind also scans it for class names. Empty string means the bundled defaults.

static.description: Directory copied verbatim into the build output. Use for images, fonts, favicon, robots.txt. Default 'static'.

dark_mode.description: Dark mode strategy. 'auto' derives the dark palette from your light tokens. 'manual' expects explicit dark variants in main.css. 'off' disables dark mode entirely.

ai_targets.description: Not implemented yet: the build does not read this key. Reserved for the 'Open in AI' button targets.

items.description: Supported LLM chat target for the 'Open in AI' button.

enabled.description: Generate the cross-format search index at build time.

typo_tolerance.description: Fraction of term length allowed as edit distance. 0.2 = up to 1 edit per 5 chars. 0 disables typo tolerance.

markdown.description: Search ranking boost for markdown pages.

html.description: Search ranking boost for HTML pages.

openapi.description: Search ranking boost for OpenAPI operations and schemas.

proto.description: Search ranking boost for proto messages and RPCs.

jsonschema.description: Search ranking boost for JSON Schema fields and definitions.

weights.description: Per-format search ranking weights, applied via MiniSearch boostDocument.

on_broken_links.description: What to do when a relative link, link fragment or colocated image does not resolve. 'error' fails the build; 'warn' prints the report and continues.

description: aid project configuration. Generated JSON Schema is published at https://aid.tools/schemas/v0/aid.schema.json.
